name: dy0
expr: if(n > 0, B / 2 * (sin(90 deg * 1 / n) - sin(90 deg * 0 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dz0
expr: if(n > 0, D * (cos(90 deg * 0 / n) - cos(90 deg * 1 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dy1
expr: if(n > 1, B / 2 * (sin(90 deg * 2 / n) - sin(90 deg * 1 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dz1
expr: if(n > 1, D * (cos(90 deg * 1 / n) - cos(90 deg * 2 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dy2
expr: if(n > 2, B / 2 * (sin(90 deg * 3 / n) - sin(90 deg * 2 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dz2
expr: if(n > 2, D * (cos(90 deg * 2 / n) - cos(90 deg * 3 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dy3
expr: if(n > 3, B / 2 * (sin(90 deg * 4 / n) - sin(90 deg * 3 / n)), 0 mm)

name: dz3
expr: if(n > 3, D * (cos(90 deg * 3 / n) - cos(90 deg * 4 / n)), 0 mm)

name: Pkey
expr: r1 * (pi + 2 * alK / 1 rad) + r2 * (pi - 2 * alK / 1 rad) + 2 * dK * cos(alK)
